# LinkedIn Prospecting and Personalized Outreach


## Activation
Use for identifying LinkedIn prospects, building buyer personas, learning the user's outreach voice, writing connection invitations, first messages and follow-ups, converting inbound attention into qualified inquiries, and measuring replies.

## Workflow
1. Define an ideal customer profile by company situation, buying trigger, role and problem—not job title alone.
2. Separate account selection (which company) from persona selection (which person and why they would care).
3. Build two to four practical persona cards. Each card states their likely problem, buying context, evidence needed and a reason to engage.
4. Learn the user's voice from three to five real messages they wrote, if supplied. Do not fabricate examples or imitate another person's private messages.
5. Research each lead using permitted public information. Attach one verifiable, relevant fact and its source/date to each draft. If there is no useful fact, do not pretend personalization exists.
6. Draft a concise invitation, first message and up to two follow-ups. Keep the first contact focused on relevance and curiosity, not a full service pitch.
7. Show every message for approval. Never send an invitation, DM or follow-up without the user's explicit approval of the exact action.
8. Review acceptance and reply rates after a consistent measurement window, segmented by persona. Treat BeReach's published performance figures as vendor-reported claims, not guaranteed outcomes.
9. For inbound leads, inspect the path from content/profile visit to inquiry, identify the weak conversion step, and improve the offer or response process before increasing outreach volume.

## ChatGPT-specific setup safety
Before consulting the upstream bereach-setup skill, read references/BEAREACH_SETUP_SAFETY_OVERRIDE.md. Its memory-cleanup instructions are Claude-specific and must not be applied to ChatGPT. Never delete or alter ChatGPT Memory, instructions, chats, projects or existing skills as part of outreach setup.

## No BeReach connection
The persona, voice and message frameworks can be applied to lead details the user provides or that are gathered from permitted public sources. Do not claim to have discovered, enriched, sent to or measured a lead unless a connected tool actually did so.

## Boundaries
Do not scrape LinkedIn, bypass access controls, use stealth browser automation, mass-invite, or auto-message. The upstream repository's sending and measurement workflow depends on BeReach; this ChatGPT skill does not install BeReach or grant access to its paid services. Ask before connecting a paid provider or spending credits.
